verdict.rationale: GitHub documents an official Copilot CLI that lets you use Copilot directly from your terminal, with install docs. Separately, local sandboxes let Copilot interact with code, tools and the filesystem on your local machine, which supports local agentic execution. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the CLI runs autonomous agent-mode tasks (planning, editing, executing) rather than just chat, and independent hands-on corroboration of terminal agent use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.
Cloud and local sandboxes provide isolated execution environments that let Copilot safely interact with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources securely on your local machine
